title: Bell peppers, Tomato and Stew
description: Eggplant stew – A lovely and refreshing choice for a family meal. This Vibrant color, robustly flavored Eggplant stew is loaded with Onions, Red bell peppers, Yellow bell peppers, Green bell peppers, and Scallions.

review.reviewBody: I found this recipe a year ago when I didn't know what to do with an eggplant and it immediately became a favorite. I have actually never had smoked fish on hand, but the stew is so good even without that I forget! Potatoes and corn are a tasty addition when skipping the fish. I haven't been much of a cook before, but I'm starting to learn more and am so excited to finally explore the rest of your recipes. Thank you Lola!
Great base recipe!!!  2nd time I added black beans and we rolled the mixture in tortillas…..Mediterranea and Middle East meets Mex!!! Yummy. Thank you for a delicious base 👍🏽

Delicious and so easy to make. I put some hot peppers in it. Eggplant is so healthy veggie. Thank you for the recipe. I forgot to make pictures for instagram 😔😔😔. And I thought I make for two days. NOT! Almost seeing the bottem of my pan.😊😊😊. So I ll make a little side dish with rice with the rest of your eggplant stew. Have a nice day! 👌👌👌💖💖💖
I love eating eggplant with a variety of bell peppers. Never heard of a stew with them. This sounds so flavorful and yummy.
So easy and flavorful! I'm loving this recipe!
I’m always looking for new veggie packed stews to try and this looks delicious.
This is so bright and colorful! And your photos are making me hungry, looks delicious! Pinning this one!
Never had eggplant prepared this way but I'm so excited to try, the flavors sound amazing in this dish!
Just the title alone makes me excited - three of my favourite ingredients! Delicious :)
This is comfort food for the win!
I love dishes full of veggies like this one!  This is some serious comfort food!
I love the addition of the smoked fish to this recipe. It looks very tasty indeed. Thanks for sharing, I will have to whip it up! Cheers
